verdict.rationale: The AMD Instinct MI325X is a GPU accelerator with a supporting compute software stack (ROCm, SMI, GPU Operator, Spur scheduler). Versioning, reviewing, and rolling back user automations is a workflow-automation axis that falls outside this product category. Nothing in the evidence shows the product ships any automation versioning or rollback capability that would make the axis apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
